notes.title: New update v1.01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We've updated the game with a small life improvement fixes.
You can check the humble patch notes below:

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improvements: You can now use the mouse as a controller in the Multiplayer Settings menu
[*] Balancing: Unlocking a character price lowered
[*] Balancing: Removed rolling for rewards with diamonds, because it was not really worth it. Additionally, players could mistakenly spend all diamonds on rerolls.
[/list]

If you happen to find any more tiny issues within the game, feel free to let us know under this announcement. Thank you!

Enjoy your time in Jumping Joe!

notes.title: Jumping Joe! - Friends Edition is Live Now
notes.notes:
Greetings,

We’re more than excited to announce that Jumping Joe! - Friends Editionis now available on Steam!

[previewyoutube=sqE4dbKA2Zs;full][/previewyoutube]

Jumping Joe! - Friends Edition is a must-have for any casual and couch game fans. It offers more depth than those cartoony graphics might suggest to you.

Play Solo - unlock new characters and their special skills or challenge yourself in more hardcore modes.
- or play with your friends for up to 4 players on the same screen! - Highly suggested if you ask us.

"Simplistic but highly approachable, with an addictive gameplay hook and cheap entry fee." - Cubed3.com
"For a game named like a pop-up children’s restaurant, Jumping Joe is unexpectedly rife with tension" - New Game Network

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1273590/extras/flying_Joe.gif?t=1588950188[/img]

Have fun and leave a review if you liked it.

Best from Vixa Games
